title: Plan for Change: Updates to policy-related reporting in Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse
summary: Starting January 4, 2027, Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse will update policy-related reporting collections, possibly causing changes in policy-status counts. Existing connections and schemas remain unchanged, and no action is required. Differences from Intune admin center reports may occur due to timing and aggregation.
body:
Starting January 4, 2027, or soon after, we are updating Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse infrastructure to align policy-related reporting with updated Intune reporting infrastructure. This update applies to the following collections:

- policyDeviceActivities- policyTypeActivities- policyUserActivities- deviceConfigurationProfileDeviceActivities- deviceConfigurationProfileUserActivities- compliancePolicyStatusDeviceActivities- compliancePolicyStatusDevicePerPolicyActivities

[How this will affect your organization:]

Existing Data Warehouse connections and report schemas will remain unchanged. Following this update, you may notice differences in policy-status counts in reports that use the affected collections. 

Note: Counts in Data Warehouse may also differ from reports in the Intune admin center due to differences in refresh timing and data aggregation.

[What you need to do to prepare:]

No action is required. If your organization uses the affected collections for custom reporting or analysis, you may notice that policy-status counts may change following the update.

Learn more: Use the Intune Data Warehouse - Microsoft Intune | Microsoft Learn
